effect_scopes.analysis_strategy: Primary full-analysis-set comparison of randomized trial groups; randomized patients without assessable outcome data were excluded from that population.

source_spans.exact_text:
The primary analysis was performed in the full analysis population, which included all the patients who underwent randomization and had assessable outcome data. Patients who underwent randomization and had available baseline data were included in the safety analysis. After evaluations by the event-adjudication committee and imaging-evaluation committee, patients who did not meet the inclusion criteria were excluded from the per-protocol population. The analyses in the per-protocol population were performed as secondary analyses.

We compared the results for the primary, secondary, and safety outcomes between the trial groups without adjustment for stratification variables.

effect_scopes.analysis_strategy: Main efficacy analysis in the intention-to-treat population; per-protocol analysis was a sensitivity analysis.

source_spans.exact_text: Efficacy and safety analyses were performed in the intention-to-treat population in the main analysis and in the per-protocol population in a sensitivity analysis.

source_spans.exact_text: The primary analysis was performed on the basis of the intention-to-treat principle and used a two-sided Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney test for superiority to assess the distribution of scores on the modified Rankin scale at the 90-day follow-up.
